resources.string: Scan with Nuvio on your phone
Connect the phone to the same network as the TV.
On the phone open Settings → TV remote → Scan TV code.
Frame this code: the phone can then control playback.
Shows a QR code to scan with the Nuvio app on your phone, to control playback from the phone.
Could not start pairing: check that the TV is connected to the network.
%1$s is now paired with this TV.
Paired phones can see what is playing and control playback and volume. Everything stays on your local network and is encrypted with a key unique to each phone. Remove a phone to revoke its access.
